### Jesus, the First and the Last
Author: Steffen Mueller
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-first-and-last
Passage: Revelation 1:17-18
Points:
- John and the early church faced harsh persecution, needing Christ's reassurance as the First and Last.
- As the First, Jesus is the divine Creator who purposeful designs our circumstances for His glory.
- We cannot truly understand our own identity without knowing Christ personally.
- As the Last, Jesus directs the course of history and will judge all people.
- Honoring Christ for who He is—not just for what we want from Him—enables us to withstand trials.

### Power over Death
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/power-over-death
Passage: Revelation 1:17-20
Points:
- The vision's rich imagery conveys Christ's overwhelming majesty rather than a literal physical likeness.
- Beholding the risen Christ drove John to his face in reverent awe and trembling.
- Jesus comforted John by revealing that He has conquered death through His resurrection.
- Christ holds the keys of death and Hades, exercising absolute authority over human mortality.
- Jesus actively guards and upholds His churches in His sovereign hands.
- Believers need not fear death because Christ has atoned for sin and made death powerless.
